newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-YELLOW CARDS AND SUSPENSIONS IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YELLOW CARDS AND SUSPENSIONS IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.

text.p: The following list shows players
with yellow cards going into this week's European Cup champions'
league matches and those suspended from playing in this week's
UEFA Cup and champions' league competitions:
Champions' league
Group A
AUXERRE - Suspended: Alain Goma. Yellow cards: Sabri
Lamouchi, Lilian Laslandes, Bernard Diomede, Philippe Violeau,
Taribo West, Antoine Sibierski.
GRASSHOPPER ZURICH - Suspended: Murat Yakin, Viorel Moldovan
Yellow cards: Joel Magnin, Kubilay Turkyilmaz, Berndt Haas,
Antonio Esposito, Harald Gamperle.
AJAX - Suspended: Marcio Santos. Yellow cards: Mario
Melchiot, Roderick Turpijn
GLASGOW RANGERS - Suspended: Paul Gascoigne. Yellow cards:
Stuart McCall, Brian Laudrup.
Group B
WIDZEW LODZ - Yellow cards: Slawomir Majak, Radoslaw
Michalski, Marek Bajor, Pavel Miaszkiewicz, Jacek Dembinksi,
Marek Citko, Pawel Wojtala, Miroslaw Szymkowiak.
STEAUA BUCHAREST - Suspended: Tibor Csik, Tudorel Zamfirescu
Yellow cards: Narcis Raducan, Sabin Ilie, Augustin Calin, Roland
Nagy, Daniel Prodan, Denis Serban, Dumitru Rosu, Marius Lacatus,
Cristian Ciocoiu, Ilie Miu
BORUSSIA DORTMUND - Yellow cards: Michael Zorc, Julio Cesar,
Wolfgang Feiersinger, Heiko Herrlich.
ATLETICO MADRID: - Suspended: Santi. Yellow cards: Milinko
Pantic, Roberto Solozabal, Toni, Radek Bejbl, Roberto.
Group C
MANCHESTER UNITED - Yellow cards: Gary Neville, Jordi
Cruyff, David Beckham
FENERBAHCE - Yellow cards: Recber Rustu, Uygun Bulent,
Senturk Kemalettin. Dogan Mustafa
JUVENTUS - Yellow cards: Alen Boksic, Didier Deschamps,
Angelo Peruzzi, Sergio Porrini
RAPID VIENNA - Suspended: Thomas Zingler. Yellow cards:
Peter Guggi, Trifon Ivanov, Peter Schoettel, Dietmar Kuhbauer,
Peter Stoeger, Andrzej Lesiak, Sergei Mandreko, Marek Penska
Group D
PORTO - Suspended: Paulinho Santos. Yellow cards: Artur
Oliveira, Fernando Mendes, Jorge Costa, Luiz Marco, Ljubinko
Drulovic, Aloisio Alves, Edmilson, Rui Barros.
ROSENBORG - Suspended: Jahn Ivar Jakobsen. Yellow cards:
Jon Olav Hjelde, Roar Strand, Tom Staurvik, Bent Skammelsrud,
Harald Brattbakk, Bjorn Kvarme, Bjorn Bragstad.
AC MILAN - Suspended: Demetrio Albertini. Yellow cards:
Marco Simone, Alessandro Costacurta, Marcel Desailly, George
Weah, Stefano Eranio.
IFK GOTHENBURG - Yellow cards: Magnus Erlingmark, Jesper
Blomqvist, Stefan Lindqvist, Mikael Martinsson
